dos: Headline-driven, benefit-first ('How Dell Helps Partners…', '5 Ways…', 'Win Customer PC Refresh Deals')
Mixed-case article titles in display face
Short eyebrow labels (≤3 words) UPPERCASE in mono
Editorial serif decks under article H1s (2-3 lines, italic 18px)
donts: No editorial-larping vocabulary (atelier, the studio, the journal, mise-en-place)
No ALL-CAPS article titles or section openers
No persistent global hero on inner pages
No card-without-metadata (every card carries topic chip · date · read-time · author)
No coloured full-bleed strips as section dividers
No more than two CTAs per editorial block

iaPriorities.evidence: 614 articles in sitemap; same article promoted in 3 home sections; users come via Google as much as via home.
iaPriorities.implication: Header search affordance must be visible (not buried in MENU). Article URLs preserved exactly (no slug changes that would break inbound links).

iaPriorities.evidence: Channel Company is publisher; Dell Technologies is sponsor — disclosed on every page in current site.
iaPriorities.implication: Utility-strip role at site-top + footer co-brand lockups. Cannot be hidden, can be quieter.

iaPriorities.evidence: Newsletter form on every page (right rail in current site); 3-field email capture.
iaPriorities.implication: Dedicated home block (not stuffed into rail with ad). Per-article footer always renders newsletter signup + 'read more like this' link.

iaPriorities.evidence: 17 sections (newsroom 147, storage 97, commercial-pcs 55, server 48, …); topic clusters drive both nav and editorial grouping.
iaPriorities.implication: Primary nav exposes top-level topics inline at desktop. Home page 'By Topic' block is one of the four canonical home blocks.

narrative.northStar: A small Bloomberg Businessweek for the Dell channel. Editorial chrome, premium B2B colour, considered type. The brand teal #003049 stays as anchor; new secondaries (navy-deep, brass, cordovan) carry editorial accents. Three type families with distinct functions replace the single Roboto skin and let typography carry the hierarchy that full-bleed coloured strips used to fake.
narrative.overview: Mode-A brand-faithful refresh. Primary palette pinned by user (#003049 teal, black, white). Secondaries open and resolved to enterprise-refined direction (navy-deep, brass, cordovan). Type system fully open and resolved to multi-family (Geist display, Source Serif 4 editorial, Inter UI, Geist Mono data) on a 1.25 modular scale. Density balanced (64/48/32px section padding). IA cleanup: kill section glut, single canonical taxonomy, build missing section indexes, fix broken nav.
keyCharacteristics: Three type families with distinct functions (display / editorial / UI / mono)
Modular 1.25 type scale (10 steps from 12 to 60 px)
Pinned primaries + 3 enterprise secondaries (no consumer-grade saturation)
Cards earn opens via metadata (chip · date · read-time · author)
Mixed-case headings; UPPERCASE only for ≤3-word eyebrows + CTAs
Persistent global hero killed on inner pages
13+ home-page section glut consolidated to 4 editorial blocks
Single canonical IA (drop /category/ duplicates; build missing indexes)
Token-driven; zero hard-coded values in component CSS
rules: Every CSS value reads from a token at :root — colours, type sizes, spacing, radius, shadow.
No card without metadata (chip · date · read-time · author).
No coloured full-bleed strip as a section divider.
No ALL-CAPS for article titles, section openers, decks, body, or card titles.
No persistent global hero on inner pages — page-chrome-bar replaces it.
Topic chips cycle by category cluster from a fixed 4-variant palette.
Article body in editorial serif at 18 px / 68 ch measure.
Inline body links: 1 px ink underline at descender; 2 px brass on hover.
Reduced-motion respected on every animated element.
dos: Use mixed-case for all headings, decks, and card titles in the display face.
Reserve UPPERCASE for short eyebrow labels, topic chips (mono 11 px), primary CTAs.
Lead with the lead story on home — single editorial hero composition, not a stock-photo band.
Give every card a topic chip · date · read-time · author meta row.
Render article body in Source Serif 4 at 18 px / 1.6 line-height / 68 ch measure.
Use --brass for considered hover accents (inline link underline thickening).
Use --navy-deep for large editorial bands (footer top, featured-story background).
donts: Do not stack 13 section-label strips on the home page; consolidate to 4 editorial blocks.
Do not render the persistent 'Enterprise Tech Provider · Stay ahead…' band on inner pages.
Do not render article H1s in UPPERCASE on a teal band.
Do not put cards in a grid without metadata.
Do not let co-brand attribution outweigh the site mark in the header.
Do not auto-advance the YouTube reels carousel.
Do not use Bootstrap 3 default chrome (flat tiles, sharp corners on everything, no shadow language).
Do not introduce more than 2 CTAs per editorial block.
